values: TO-DO
IN-PROGRESS
DONE
PARTIALLY DONE

Manuscript and TA requirements
Not done — Final Gantt chart: A provisional planning schedule is not a finalized chart tied to confirmed dates.

Manuscript and TA requirements
In progress — System Architecture: The combined framework/architecture figure is present, but a separate “[Insert System Architecture]” placeholder still appears below it. This needs a later decision and was outside this Chapter 2 edit.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Introduction: Five opening paragraphs establish context before the detailed problem, following Sir Dhan’s direction.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Deferred — Cost and operational feasibility sign-off: Actual or approved costs, a complete schedule basis, and evidence of institutional operational acceptance are still needed.

Manuscript and TA requirements
In progress — Scope and Limitations: Scope precedes a paragraph beginning “However,” but the section has two paragraphs. Sir Dhan’s wording about a single integrated paragraph warrants final confirmation.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Statement of the Problem: It begins with the information problem, uses the initial survey as evidence, and does not present the application as the opening solution.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Deferred — Post-use evaluation: The instrument, evaluator groups, procedure, and ISO/IEC 25010 results are not finalized; no evaluation findings appear in Chapters 1–3.

Manuscript and TA requirements
In progress — Time and Place: The section identifies Bacoor and the study period, but its dates and brevity need a final evidence check.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Objectives: The development objective identifies Flutter and the development approach; major functions are listed, while testing and evaluation objectives remain concise.

Research evidence and data
Deferred — Operational susceptibility and center-data approval: The approved research-data directory contains no established operational susceptibility dataset. Provisional material and data requests do not prove receipt, approval, or integration; current authorized center records also need confirmation.

Manuscript and TA requirements
In progress — Chapter 2 source sign-off: The chapter discusses four foreign and four local system studies with methods and reported outputs. A final source-by-source citation and recency check remains prudent, especially for the retained 2020 local study; this formatting-only turn did not revalidate every publication.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Theoretical Framework modules: Five function-named modules include Authentication. The database is supporting infrastructure, not a main module; the administrator appears on the right of the combined figure.

System development
Not done — Fixed-schema parameter CSV: The confirmed export/import requirement lacks the complete ordinary-Admin workflow, validation, and end-to-end evidence needed to call it implemented.

Manuscript and TA requirements
In progress — Appendices: Fishbone and two resident-flow diagrams are inserted as Appendices A–C. Their embedded captions and final correspondence with the system still need review. Provisional Use Case, DFD, and HIPO files exist but are not finalized in the manuscript.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Chapter 2 organization and tables: Foreign/local literature and studies, synthesis, research gap, and Tables 1–3 are present. This turn completed their visual formatting without adding studies or marks.

System development
Not done — Assessment history, offline operation, and production deployment: The audit found no completed resident assessment-history function, offline capability, or verified production release.

Manuscript and TA requirements
In progress — Separate feasibility study: Materials exist, but older feasibility claims include superseded technology and the current budget and operational evidence are incomplete. It remains separate from Chapter 3, as requested.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Chapter 3 Materials and Method: Materials cover research gathering as well as development. The Method distinguishes developmental research, Evolutionary Prototyping, and Kanban, with one methodology figure.

Research evidence and data
In progress — Interview record consolidation: BDRRMO interview records are available. The canonical CPDCO recording/transcript and associated permissions should be confirmed before final evidentiary sign-off.

Manuscript and TA requirements
Done — Participants and statistical treatment: Chapter 3 reports 40 purposively selected qualified respondents and uses the survey’s frequency, percentage, and applicable item-mean procedures. It does not present the needs survey as system evaluation.

Research evidence and data
In progress — Local geographic validation: The 47-barangay layer serves as a technically checked administrative reference, not a City-verified flood-susceptibility dataset.

Research evidence and data
Done — Initial needs assessment: The report analyzes 40 qualified respondents from 14 barangays and documents sampling and response-quality limitations. Its findings apply to that surveyed group, not all Bacoor residents.

Research evidence and data
In progress — Alignment tracker: Its September audit predates the October development changes and completed initial survey. It needs a separate evidence-based update, not an automatic status carryover.

System development
Done as software functions — Resident assessment flow: The October 11 audit found scenario confirmation, manual selection/map pin, optional foreground GPS, deterministic rule matching, susceptibility output, explanation, and map presentation integrated. This does not validate the local susceptibility facts.

System development
In progress — Verification: The October 11 audit records 389 passing mobile tests and clean Flutter analysis. The 891 backend tests are historical evidence from October 5, not a current rerun; scientific, user, and production validation remain separate.

System development
Done as software functions — Access and administration: Resident authentication and account controls, custom Admin access, governed content workflows, and audit history are integrated. Ordinary Admin users are not given raw-rule editing.

System development
Done as software functions — Preparedness and centers: Structured DSS guidance and resident nearest-center lookup are integrated; public usefulness still depends on approved, current guidance and center records.

System development
Done — Center-record import: A staged evacuation-center CSV/XLSX workflow exists. It is distinct from Expert System parameter exchange.

OUT OF SCOPE (not a pending task)
System development
Not done by scope — Live monitoring and automatic action: FloodSense does not claim real-time rainfall or water-level monitoring, official forecasting or warnings, autonomous alerts, safe-road routing, live center occupancy, background GPS tracking, or automatic evacuation orders.
